proposedAdditions.name: Elecoglipron
proposedAdditions.stage: Phase IIb results; Phase III programme announced
proposedAdditions.summary: AstraZeneca reported VISTA and SOLSTICE results and advancement into EMBOLD obesity and ELUMINATE diabetes development. This does not verify initiation of every planned trial.
proposedAdditions.ukAuthorisation: Not established for this weight-management programme by the reviewed evidence; requires separate MHRA/product-information verification.
proposedAdditions.nhsEngland: Not established by these research sources; no routine access claim proposed.
proposedAdditions.supply: UK retail availability and stock unverified. Research development does not establish supply.
proposedAdditions.limitations: Gastrointestinal adverse events were common. Obesity, diabetes, combination and outcome studies require separate stage checks.
proposedAdditions.publicationStatus: proposed; not imported into the live catalogue

proposedAdditions.name: Olatorepatide / HS-20094
proposedAdditions.stage: Chinese NDA accepted following Phase III
proposedAdditions.summary: Hansoh reports Chinese acceptance of its weight-management application for a weekly GLP-1/GIP injection. Acceptance is not marketing approval.
proposedAdditions.ukAuthorisation: Not established for this weight-management programme by the reviewed evidence; requires separate MHRA/product-information verification.
proposedAdditions.nhsEngland: Not established by these research sources; no routine access claim proposed.
proposedAdditions.supply: UK retail availability and stock unverified. Research development does not establish supply.
proposedAdditions.limitations: Regeneron is the partner outside Hansoh's retained territories. Do not confuse this asset with the Hansoh/Merck oral programme or infer a UK licence.
proposedAdditions.publicationStatus: proposed; not imported into the live catalogue

proposedAdditions.name: Apitegromab with tirzepatide
proposedAdditions.summary: The EMBRAZE paper reports less lean-mass loss with the combination over 24 weeks; exploratory physical-function measures showed no notable group differences.
proposedAdditions.ukAuthorisation: Not established for this weight-management programme by the reviewed evidence; requires separate MHRA/product-information verification.
proposedAdditions.nhsEngland: Not established by these research sources; no routine access claim proposed.
proposedAdditions.supply: UK retail availability and stock unverified. Research development does not establish supply.
proposedAdditions.limitations: Lean mass is not equivalent to strength or function. Adverse events included gastrointestinal symptoms. The current pipeline page does not establish continuing obesity development; do not classify this as an advancing obesity programme or infer an obesity indication from another indication.
proposedAdditions.publicationStatus: proposed; not imported into the live catalogue

proposedAdditions.name: Trevogrumab with semaglutide, with or without garetosmab
proposedAdditions.stage: Phase II COURAGE results published in 2025
proposedAdditions.summary: Regeneron reported body-composition findings for these experimental combinations. The triplet had more discontinuations and two deaths; the sponsor did not establish causation.
proposedAdditions.ukAuthorisation: Not established for this weight-management programme by the reviewed evidence; requires separate MHRA/product-information verification.
proposedAdditions.nhsEngland: Not established by these research sources; no routine access claim proposed.
proposedAdditions.supply: UK retail availability and stock unverified. Research development does not establish supply.
proposedAdditions.limitations: This is an older coverage omission, not a September 2026 result. Safety, functional outcomes and current programme status require further review. Do not portray lean-mass preservation as an established clinical benefit.
proposedAdditions.publicationStatus: proposed; not imported into the live catalogue

fields.benefit: Lilly reported detailed Phase 3 TRIUMPH-2 results on 29 September 2026 in adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity or overweight. Retatrutide remains investigational.
tradeoffs: Gastrointestinal adverse events, dysesthesia and treatment discontinuations were reported.
A US submission is planned for Q1 2027; this is neither a completed submission nor UK approval.

proposedUpdates.preserve: Existing MHRA, UK authorisation and access wording and evidence; this proposal does not resolve the separate access-context review in PR 815.

fields.stage: Phase III ENITH-1/2 ongoing; separate Phase II diabetes results
fields.summary: Roche reported CT388-104 results on 22 September 2026 in adults with type 2 diabetes and overweight or obesity. ENITH-1/2 weight-management trials are ongoing; additional diabetes and cardiovascular Phase III studies are planned for the first half of 2027.
fields.limitations: Sponsor-reported results; gastrointestinal adverse events and discontinuations occurred. Planned studies and research results do not establish UK authorisation, NHS access or supply.

proposedUpdates.preserve: Keep April presentation and June evidence as dated historical records; do not renew their review dates.
